name: NuPhy Premium OEM/Cherry Profile Grey White PBT Keycap Set (Missing Few Keys)
description: Selling an authentic NuPhy mechanical keyboard keycap set in a clean minimalist grey and white colorway. Made from high-quality, durable PBT material with dye-subbed crisp legends that won't fade or shine over time. Perfect upgrade for custom mechanical keyboards, macro pads, or for salvaging individual keycaps to complete your layout! PLEASE NOTE: This set is missing a few keycaps (specifically 'I', 'O', and a couple of function rows/accent blocks as shown in the photo). If you have a smaller 60%/65% layout or just need replacements/spares, this is an absolute steal. Coming from a pet-friendly home with a lovely cat, but everything has been thoroughly sanitized, inspected, and wiped down prior to listing.
model: Standard Profile Dye-Sub PBT Keycap Set
contact_note: Includes the original clear plastic sorting trays for easy transport and keycap organization. Since this is a soft accessory set without an outer fabric layer, it does NOT come with an additional storage bag. Please bring a small pouch or backpack if you prefer to carry it out of the tray. Comes from a cat-friendly home, fully sanitized, but there might be faint unseen pet traces. Price reflects the missing keys perfectly!
meta_description: Affordable NuPhy grey and white PBT keycap set with a few missing keys. High-quality dye-sublimated legends, perfect for replacement parts or smaller 60% mechanical keyboards.
name_zh: NuPhy 灰白拼色 PBT 机械键盘键帽套装 (缺件残套)
description_zh: 转让一套正品 NuPhy 机械键盘灰白配色键帽。高品质 PBT 材质，热升华字符清晰耐磨，长期使用不打油、不掉色。极简工业风配色，非常适合客制化键盘玩家作为替换件、组装客制化小键盘（如60%/65%等小配列）或者用来补充其他残套。请务必注意：如图所示，本套键帽缺失了几个键位（包括‘I’键、‘O’键以及个别功能键区/增补键位），属于非全套残包，因此低价捡漏出。卖家家里养猫，发货/自提前已经用酒精彻底擦拭消毒并清理干净，但可能残留微量猫咪毛发痕迹，介意者请绕道。价格已经根据缺件情况降到最低，不接大刀！
